title: Containment of compatible strict-henselization residue images
statement: Let g:T→S be a scheme morphism and k,k′ separably closed fields, Ω an algebraically closed field, σ:Spec k→S, τ:Spec k′→T, ι:Spec k′→Spec k with ι≫σ=τ≫g, and ν:Spec Ω→Spec k′. Let A,B be strictly henselian local rings with separably closed residue fields, eA:Spec A≅S_(ν≫ι≫σ), eB:Spec B≅T_(ν≫τ), and residue embeddings ρA,ρB whose composites through the closed-point and structural maps equal σ and τ. Let a:κA→k′ be the ring homomorphism corresponding to ι≫ρA and b:κB→k′ the one corresponding to ρB. For every x∈κA there exists y∈κB with b(y)=a(x). This is containment of field images only, with no map between A and B. The scheme, geometric point, residue field, strictly henselian ring and strict-henselization constructions are those of [def-pc-scheme] [def-pc-separably-closed] [def-weil-geometric-point] [def-weil-residue-field] [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology] [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit] [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-structural-map].

source.place: Tag 04HX, identification of pointed-neighbourhood colimits with strict henselizations; Tag 095T, inclusion κ(s)^sep ⊂ κ(t)^sep in the proof

proof.text: For each residue element obtain a nonzero separable polynomial over the second model residue field whose image vanishes at the specified image of x.
The polynomial splits because the second residue field is separably closed. Polynomial.Splits.mem_range_of_isRoot applied to the mapped root gives a preimage, proving the elementwise containment.

lean.statement: theorem Etale.compatibleStrictHenselization_residue_image {S T : Scheme.{u}} {g : T ⟶ S} {k k' Ω A B : Type u} [Field k] [IsSepClosed k] [Field k'] [IsSepClosed k'] [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [HenselianLocalRing A] [HenselianLocalRing B] [IsSepClosed (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)] [IsSepClosed (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B)] (σ : Spec (.of k) ⟶ S) (τ : Spec (.of k') ⟶ T) (ι : Spec (.of k') ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (hι : ι ≫ σ = τ ≫ g) (ν : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec (.of k')) (eA : Spec (.of A) ≅ strictHenselizationScheme (ν ≫ ι ≫ σ)) (eB : Spec (.of B) ≅ strictHenselizationScheme (ν ≫ τ)) (ρA : Spec (.of k) ⟶ Spec (.of (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A))) (ρB : Spec (.of k') ⟶ Spec (.of (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B))) (hρA : ρA ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (IsLocalRing.residue A)) ≫ eA.hom ≫ strictHenselizationStructuralMap (ν ≫ ι ≫ σ) = σ) (hρB : ρB ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (IsLocalRing.residue B)) ≫ eB.hom ≫ strictHenselizationStructuralMap (ν ≫ τ) = τ) : ∀ x : IsLocalRing.ResidueField A, ∃ y : IsLocalRing.ResidueField B, (Spec.preimage ρB).hom y = (Spec.preimage (ι ≫ ρA)).hom x
